decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
Histology showed diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
CD42b immunohistochemical staining showed platelet aggregation in cardiac microvessels
response.rationale: COVID-19-associated myocarditis is most likely given confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, cardiac histology showing lymphocytic myocarditis, and elevated inflammatory cytokines. R4 is a broader myocarditis label but lacks the specific viral etiology.

rejected.why: Thrombocytopenia and platelet aggregation are present but are secondary to the viral infection and not the primary diagnosis; no systemic microangiopathy features.
ST elevation and elevated cardiac markers are explained by myocarditis; absence of coronary stenosis contradicts ACS.
Pulmonary findings are consistent with COVID-19 lung involvement but the dominant clinical and pathological picture is cardiac.
